scope:
Bounded SH-4 costs for current-source UV validation, admission and packing.

The complete production actor TU uses Make-derived flags, and the fixture
retains its actual checked_certificate, pack_uv16 and uv_decide helpers. Costs are added
CPU work relative to UV32, which has no pack loop. Cold-I is one isolated
initially cold 8 KiB instruction cache with perfect D-cache. Reported 32-byte
data lines are address footprints, not measured cache misses. No GPU saving
or whole-actor gain is inferred from PVR internal 24-to-20-byte vertex fields.

division_controls.scope: All M/Q/T inputs; preserves remaining state; one instruction; no data traffic; DIV1 unsupported.

model.scope:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.

scenario.label: MODELLED
scenario.note: Added current-source validation, admission and cache-pack CPU work only; ignores all GPU benefit and any saved geometry.

limitations: Excludes conversion-time certificates, UI binding/handshake, counter logging, window splits and new headers, clipper interpolation, source transforms/lights, D-cache misses and GPU. Cache and SQ packet remain 32 bytes/vertex. The PVR internal relevant vertex fields change 24 to 20 bytes; no hardware throughput gain is claimed.

traffic.scope: Actual opcode operand accesses; source/cache/globals use cached SH-4 RAM addresses, code/literals and the interpreter stack use the established low synthetic map. Instruction fetches are excluded; PC-relative literals count as data. Distinct 32-byte lines are address footprints, not measured cache fills or hardware bus transactions.
